note: Private park on US-36 at the north edge of Seneca, formerly Bailey's RV Resort and under new owners since 2025; a few pads front a stocked fishing pond, the rest stand on a gravel yard. Lodge rental, storm shelter and social hall with Sunday worship. --Claude
summary: Operator site + own engine: $50 a night (all sites, June 2027 quote), $215/wk, $600/mo; 50 A full hookups, pull-throughs to 45 ft; Good Sam Park; Google 4.7/78, phone 785-294-1208 (stored entry has none). Pond (~2.8 acres) kept for the south-shore row.
flags: PHONE (apply.py does not write it): add 785-294-1208 (rates page, park rules, Good Sam directory, Google Maps). The entry has no phone now.

PRIVATE GATE FACTS: $50.00 a night for every site, dated by the park's own booking engine for 06/09/2027 (read 2026-11-06) and the 2026 rates page; exactly $50, not over the US$50 gate, and a Good Sam Park (directory gs true; site 'Good Sam Verified RV Park') so members pay ~$45. gateways.py not needed. Presence passes: working site + phone; Google 4.7 from 78 reviews. RV Life 4.5, $$.

LONG-STAY (judgement for AWH): monthly $600 is far below 30 x $50, seasonal stays are advertised, campers can leave rigs in storage at $50/month, and there is a Sunday worship service in the social hall. Test 1: no seasonal-only sites stated; test 2: nightly rate posted and booked online; test 3: no lots for sale; test 4: on a June 2027 Wednesday 10 sites (#01, 02, 04, 06-12) were open to nightly booking, so most sites appear to sell nights; test 5: no approval rule. Leans toward a travel park on US-36 with a monthly side; not a drop on what I read.

WATERFRONT: pond kept. The pond is ~125 x 90 m (~2.8 acres, under 5 acres so pond-class, not lake). A row of 4-5 pads (around 39.8423,-96.0794) faces its south shore across ~15-25 m of open grass berm with no road between; the other sites stand on the gravel yard and get nothing. Weak spot: Esri imagery may predate the 2025 owners' changes.
PIN: stored 39.8421,-96.0784 is at the office/entrance; the RV yard and pond pads are 50-100 m north and west. Fine.
